parts.text: Give me a comprehensive overview of quantum computing and its applications. Build it as a structured research report with sources.

property.description: The agent calls set_research_query with a clear report title and the user's research query.
The agent builds the report through create_section or write_report instead of pasting the full report into chat.
The agent calls add_source for authoritative references and does not imply live internet access.
When complete, the agent calls mark_research_ready with a concise one-sentence summary.
